description: The install auto-tracking (acme/weather-widget, verified) is at 1.0.5, its resolved-version high-water mark. A newly-signed index moves the channel pointer to 1.0.05 and publishes a validly-signed artifact at that string. Under MAN-002's pre-narrowing grammar both spellings were valid and parsed to the SAME triple: 1.0.05 was not lower than the mark, so MKT-050's anti-rollback never fired, and it differed from the installed version as a string, so the update path treated it as a change — a different artifact delivered at what the deployment already treated as its high-water version, with no attacker step beyond publishing a second spelling. MAN-002 now refuses a leading-zero component (one spelling per version, stated as an injectivity requirement), so 1.0.05 is not a version, has no position in MKT-050a's order, and the pointer is not resolvable — refused rather than compared, exactly as any value outside the grammar. The installed 1.0.5 and its high-water mark are untouched.

expected.rationale: 1.0.05 carries a leading zero in its PATCH component: under MAN-002's injective grammar it is a second spelling of 1.0.5, not a version, so it has no position in MKT-050a's order and no defined relation to the high-water mark
